body.name: \mathcal S_{\mathrm{TIV}}
body.def: \(\mathcal S_{\mathrm{TIV}}\) has labels \(\{A,X,Y\}\), the directed edge \(X\to Y\), bidirected edges \(A\leftrightarrow X\) and \(X\leftrightarrow Y\), and no other edges.
body.role: One-window independent-edge-latent chain in which \(A_{-1}\) reveals the instrument-side latent state and \(X_{-1}\to Y_0\) is forced by the positive-lag restriction.
